question:
The marks scored by 10 students are given below.

19, 14, 11, 20, 18, 17, 14, 10, 11, 11

The mode of the given data is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The mode of a data set is simply the number that occurs most often.

Looking at the given marks: 19, 14, 11, 20, 18, 17, 14, 10, 11, 11.

The number 11 is repeated 3 times, while 14 is repeated twice and all other numbers appear only once.

Thus, 11 has the highest frequency in the given set.

**∴ The correct answer is 11.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The marks scored by 10 students: 19, 14, 11, 20, 18, 17, 14, 10, 11, 11

**Concept Used:**

The **mode** is the specific value that appears most frequently in a given set of data observations.
